<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<title>Grow Where You're Planted — Conversation Game</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#244632">
<style>
:root {
  --table-rotation: 0deg;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: #2d261d;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%, rgba(255,255,255,.82), transparent 28%),
    linear-gradient(155deg, #f7efe1, #e8ead8 58%, #a8b79a);
  transition: background .55s ease;
}

body[data-scene] {
  background: #f6ecdf;
  --accent: #345b40;
  --accent-deep: #183c2a;
  --accent-soft: #ead8b8;
}

body[data-scene="Roots"] { --accent:#4f5f35; --accent-deep:#26371f; --accent-soft:#d9d6b1; }
body[data-scene="Field"] { --accent:#8b651f; --accent-deep:#5d4319; --accent-soft:#eed69b; }
body[data-scene="Garden"] { --accent:#8b4861; --accent-deep:#5e2f40; --accent-soft:#efd2da; }
body[data-scene="Vine"] { --accent:#58633e; --accent-deep:#303a25; --accent-soft:#d7d7b8; }
body[data-scene="Seasons"] { --accent:#54758a; --accent-deep:#2f5165; --accent-soft:#d9e4e8; }

.layer {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .45s ease;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: center;
  background-size: cover;
}

body[data-scene="Garden"] .garden-visible,
body[data-scene="Roots"] .roots-visible,
body[data-scene="Field"] .field-visible,
body[data-scene="Vine"] .vine-visible,
body[data-scene="Seasons"] .seasons-visible { opacity: 1; }

.roots-bg { z-index:0; background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(250,244,222,.04),rgba(25,35,19,.10)),url("data:image/webp;base64,"); }
.field-bg { z-index:0; background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,250,232,.02),rgba(89,59,13,.08)),url("data:image/webp;base64,
